name: Do I need a permit for a shower or tub upgrade in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a shower or tub upgrade in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: For significant shower or tub upgrades in Berkeley that involve altering plumbing lines, changing the footprint of the shower/tub, or making structural changes, a permit is typically required. Minor cosmetic updates, like replacing fixtures without plumbing alterations, usually do not require a permit. We can help determine if your project needs one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are often needed in Berkeley for major upgrades involving plumbing or structural changes. We can advise.
